---
title: ZéBolão 2026
format: html
---

```{r}
#| include: false

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

plans <- readxl::excel_sheets("planilha_mestra_26.xlsx")

apostas <- setdiff(plans, c("APOSTAS", "RESULTADOS"))

ponts <- lapply(
  apostas,
  function(plan) {
    readxl::read_xlsx(
      "planilha_mestra_26.xlsx",
      sheet = plan,
      range = readxl::cell_cols(c("H", "U")),
      .name_repair = "unique_quiet"
    ) |>
      select(1, 14) |>
      rename(data = DATA, pont = `...14`) |>
      filter(!is.na(data) & data != "DIA") |>
      mutate(data = as.Date(as.integer(data), origin = "1899-12-30"))
  }
)
names(ponts) <- apostas
```

## Pontuação por dia

```{r}
#| echo: false

acums <- lapply(
  ponts,
  function(pont) {
    bind_rows(pont, tibble::tibble(data = as.Date("2026-06-10"), pont = 0)) |>
      summarize(pont = sum(pont), .by = data) |>
      arrange(data) |>
      mutate(pontacum = cumsum(pont)) |>
      filter(data <= as.Date("2026-06-12"))
  }
)
acums <- bind_rows(acums, .id = "nome")

p <- ggplot(acums) +
  geom_line(aes(data, pontacum, color = nome)) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

plotly::ggplotly(p)
```

## Pontuação de ontem

```{r}
#| echo: false

onts <- lapply(
  ponts,
  function(pont) {
    summarize(pont, pont = sum(pont), .by = data) |>
      filter(data == as.Date("2026-06-10"))
  }
)
onts <- bind_rows(onts, .id = "nome")

if (nrow(onts) == 0) {
  cat("Não houve jogo ontem.")
} else {
  p <- ggplot(onts) +
    geom_col(aes(nome, pont)) +
    theme_minimal()

  plotly::ggplotly(p)
}
```
